verified_non_defects.title: Header icons rendered as empty boxes on mobile
verified_non_defects.initial_environment: In-app browser within the Claude iOS application
verified_non_defects.verification_result: Icons rendered correctly in Google Chrome for iOS. The person, favourites, login, and cart icons all displayed as intended.
verified_non_defects.conclusion: Not a defect. The rendering issue was caused by the in-app browser used for the initial observation, not by the application.
verified_non_defects.note: Recorded to document that a suspected issue was investigated and correctly ruled out before being raised as a defect.

note: No defect reports have been added because no reproducible defects have been confirmed.
